originality.rationale: Searches of published mathematical records, earlier scientific statements, and relevant primary work did not reveal a theorem determining the fifth-order global arclength-pair distance coefficient together with an unbounded C2-instability example. Gutkin gives derivative and curvature invariants; Pottmann gives local curve Taylor/integral-invariant statements; Clarkson introduces the two-point correlation integral but studies manifold projection bounds; Álvarez-Vizoso et al. study curvature descriptors. None of these identified statements entails the new coefficient and instability conclusion.
